verses.text: Of Solomon. God, give the king your justice. Give the king's son your goodness.
Then he will judge your people fairly and treat your poor people with justice.
Let the mountains bring peace and plenty to the people. Let the hills bring the fruit of goodness.
He will defend the poor among the people. He will save the children of those in need, and he will crush those who treat them cruelly.
People will respect you as long as the sun shines and as long as the moon lasts, for all generations.
He will be like rain falling on a cut field, like showers that water the earth.
While he rules, good people will do well, and there will be plenty of peace until the moon is gone.
He will rule from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
The desert tribes will bow down in front of him. His enemies will lick the dust.
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring him payments. The kings of Sheba and Seba will bring him gifts.
All kings will bow down to him. All nations will serve him.
He will rescue the needy when they cry out, and the poor who have no one to help them.
He will feel sorry for the weak and needy. He will save the lives of those in need.
He will rescue them from cruelty and violence. Their lives are precious to him.
Long live the king! May he be given gold from Sheba. May people always pray for him and bless him all day long.
Let there be plenty of grain all over the land, waving even on the hilltops. Let its fruit sway like the trees of Lebanon. Let the people in the cities do well, like grass in the field.
May his name last forever. May his fame continue as long as the sun shines. All nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.
Praise the LORD God, the God of Israel. He alone does amazing things.
Praise his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
This is the end of the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
